name: Vienna
summary: Two horizontal bands of red over white. The same plain flag is used by three Austrian states: Vienna, Salzburg and Vorarlberg, distinguished by their arms on state versions.
origin: Vienna's red and white colours come from its arms, a white cross on red. Salzburg and Vorarlberg also use red over white, from their own arms.
facts: Three Austrian states share this exact civil flag.
Vienna's arms are a white cross on red, similar to Switzerland's flag.
clues: Red over white, two horizontal bands, shared by three states.
The flag of a capital that is also a state.
